comparison.objective: Fit a stop pin that constrains a swinging arm to reach a work pad but not a walkway; different from tuning damping.
comparison.physical_skill: Pin alignment/insertion and mechanical range constraint versus hex-key insertion, collar rotation, locking, and iterative response tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Title gives the reach/exclusion result; body, allowable swing bounds, insertion verification, and all specs are missing.
comparison.reason: Both concern motion limits, but this tests installing a discrete geometric stop, whereas the candidate tests continuous damping adjustment and repeatable impact behavior.
